vikisozluk.baslik: رَبِشَ • (rabiša) I (non-past يَرْبَشُ (yarbašu), verbal noun رَبَش (rabaš))
anlam: to be abundant in grass with diverse colors (of plants)
to be marked with different colors in the face and/or skin (of people)
